title: Grayton Pointe Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutGrayton Pointe ~ 159 DefuniakStreet ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Grayton Pointe is an outstanding, luxurious home located on Defuniak Street in Grayton Beach – built in 2018 and never rented! Consisting of both a main house (2,829 interior sf, 562 sf covered poolside porch, sleeps 6) and a carriage house (963 interior sf, sleeps 2), Grayton Pointe will sleep a total of 8 guests and offers a 15’ x 30’ private heated pool (heating fee applies) and a 5-minute stroll (0.4 mi) to the beach and “downtown” Grayton. Driveway parking for 4 vehicles. Please note: Garage is not accessible to guests. Historic Grayton Beach is 30A’s original beach community, founded in the mid-1880’s, which has stayed true to its funky, eclectic vibe. With its designated Blue Wave beach, Grayton Beach has been listed in Dr. Steven Leatherman's (“Dr. Beach”) infamous Top 10 Beaches of America FOUR times since 1991 (#1 in 1994, #6 in 2016, #3 in 2019, #1 in 2020), thanks to its pristine coastline and untouched dunes. Grayton Pointe – and Grayton Beach itself - has so much to offer, you may never want to venture farther out along 30A! Main House Ground Level: Living room, dining table for 8, bar seating for 3, kitchen, office/den, laundry room with sink, 1 bedroom, 1.5 baths. #1 En-Suite bedroom has King bed, walk-in shower, soaking tub, his-and-her vanities, Quartz countertops, marble floors, walk-in closet (could fit pack-n-play). Main House Second Level: 2 Bedrooms, 2 baths. #2 En-Suite bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, stone countertop, walk-in closet (could fit pack-n-play). #3 En-Suite bedroom has 2 Twin beds, tub/shower, marble countertop, walk-in closet (could fit pack-n-play). Carriage House Ground Level: Powder room. Carriage House Second Level: 1 bedroom, 1 bath, living room, granite bistro dining for 2, kitchenette with Quartz countertops, stainless appliances, fridge with ice maker, built-in microwave (no oven). #4 Bedroom with Queen bed Full Bath with walk-in shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Smart TVs Sony Stereo Sony DVD Player Distinctive Features Private heated pool (natural gas, heating fee applies) Wolf, Subzero, Asko stainless appliances Rinnai tankless water heaters (main house and CH) Wolf built-in natural gas grill Hardwood floors in common areas Marble and tile floors in baths 10’-12' ceilings throughout Poolside porch dining for 6, seating area for 4-5 Built-in pool loungers (2), add’l seating for 4-5 4/10th mile to beach Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles (garage not accessible to guests) 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 Twin beds 4 full bathrooms, 2 powder rooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryers, Wolf natural gas grill w/ grill utensils, covered porch, porch furniture, pool furniture, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Quartz countertops, stainless appliances, butler’s pantry, Wolf 4-burner gas cooktop, Wolf built-in oven and microwave, Subzero fridge with ice maker and 2 freezer drawers, Asko dishwasher, Subzero wine cooler, double stainless deep sinks, coffeemaker, toaster, blender, washer/dryer. Area Features Downtown Grayton Beach (4/10th mile) TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
